text:
Evan (AE): pinging thread with Stashbridge POC redlines. procurement wants net45, PO-before-countersign, explicit test-data wipe after POC, and a KMS/HSM attestation. attaching redline.
Priya - Legal: noted. quick Q: is Stashbridge handling regulated data (PCI/HIPAA) or only standard PII? which Redwood entity will execute?
Evan (AE): they process payment analytics (PCI scope). signing entity requested is Redwood US.
Mark (SE): technical: Hosted supports CMK (customer-managed keys) but we can only provide hardware HSM attestation on Dedicated with HSM-backed KMS. For Hosted we offer procedural attestation and SOC reports.
Ruth (Presales): option: propose a 30-day Dedicated trial for the POC to satisfy HSM attestation + latency p95 SLO. note tradeoffs on cost.
Jo (Finance): net45 is fine for POC but finance requires PO and billing contact before countersign. they want invoices addressed to "Stashbridge AP" and first invoice after the first month.
Priya - Legal: redline hotspots: (1) SLA  they requested 99.99% and p95 <150ms for inference (2) KMS indemnity and warranties (3) subprocessor disclosure for embeddings vendor. we need the embeddings vendor list and data flow.
Evan (AE): SLA p95 150ms sounds tight for Hosted given their expected QPS ~15.
Mark (SE): p95 150ms lines up with Dedicated benchmarks. Hosted p95 will be higher. Recommend fallback language: commit to a latency SLO and include a Dedicated addendum for firm p95 with remedies. also include automatic routing to Dedicated if latency degrades.
Priya - Legal: draft compromise: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet agreed latency SLOs. If Customer requires a firm p95 latency SLA, parties shall execute a Dedicated deployment addendum detailing the SLA and remedies." ok?
Ruth (Presales): I'll create a one-pager comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for the POC (latency, cost delta, attestation differences). ETA EOD.
Jo (Finance): for expedited countersign (they asked 3 business days) we can e-sign if PO and billing contact are provided in advance. finance needs PO number documented on the orderform.
Priya - Legal: routing proposed: Procurement (Stashbridge) -> Stashbridge Legal -> Redwood Exec. flag: any committed spend >$150k requires VP commercial + Legal Head signoff before Exec signs.
SignBot: ACTIONS:
- Legal (Priya) to draft MSA response with Dedicated-addendum fallback and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- SE (Mark) to attach perf matrix and Dedicated trial cost estimate (ETA EOD).
- Sales (Evan) to collect PO, billing contact, and signer names from Stashbridge procurement (ETA today).
- Finance (Jo) to confirm invoice flow and net45 on orderform (ETA EOD).
Ruth (Presales): pinged Stashbridge to offer Dedicated trial and requested their subprocessor list.
Evan (AE): sample order snippet for internal alignment:
```
OrderForm:
  Customer: Stashbridge Inc
  POC term: 90 days
  Billing: Net45 (PO required before countersign)
  Deployment: Hosted default; Dedicated available via addendum/trial
  KMS: customer-managed keys; HSM attestation only on Dedicated (hardware cert)
  SLAs: latency SLO; firm p95 SLA available via Dedicated addendum
  Data: test-data deletion clause to be included; subprocessor list required
  Sign flow: Procurement -> Customer Legal -> Redwood Exec (VP commercial signoff if >$150k)
```
Evan (AE): please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to the plan.
Priya - Legal: :thumbsup:
Mark (SE): :thumbsup:
Jo (Finance): :thumbsup:
Ruth (Presales): :thumbsup:
Evan (AE): thanks all  will update when PO + signers come back from Stashbridge.
